en: as part of we the people celebrating 250 years.
zh: 作為我們人民慶祝250週年的一部分。
ja: 私たち国民が250周年を祝う一環として。
local: as part of we the people celebrating 250 years.
native: as part of we the people celebrating 250 years.

en: Here's this day in history.
zh: 這是歷史上的今天。
ja: 今日は歴史上のこの日です。
local: Here's this day in history.
native: Here's this day in history.

en: We continue to celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer.
zh: 我們今年夏天繼續慶祝美國250歲生日。
ja: 私たちはこの夏、アメリカの250回目の誕生日を祝い続けています。
local: We continue to celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer.
native: We continue to celebrate America's 250th birthday this summer.

en: We're sharing our We the People series,
zh: 我們正在分享「我們人民」系列，
ja: 私たちは「私たち国民」シリーズをお届けしています、
local: We're sharing our We the People series,
native: We're sharing our We the People series,

en: people places and things of the past that have shaped our country
zh: 過去塑造我們國家的人物、地點和事物，
ja: 私たちの国を形作った過去の人々、場所、物事を、
local: people places and things of the past that have shaped our country
native: people places and things of the past that have shaped our country

en: what it is today, including something to do
zh: 以及它今天的樣貌，包括與…有關的事物，
ja: 今日の姿、そしてそれに関係するものを含めて、
local: what it is today, including something to do
native: what it is today, including something to do

en: with our full moon out there.
zh: 與我們那裡的滿月有關。
ja: そこにある満月と関係しています。
local: with our full moon out there.
native: with our full moon out there.

en: Nice timing, Charlie.
zh: 時機真好，查理。
ja: いいタイミングだね、チャーリー。
local: Nice timing, Charlie.
native: Nice timing, Charlie.

en: Yeah, on this stage of July 29, 1958,
zh: 是的，在1958年7月29日這一天，
ja: そう、1958年7月29日のこの日に、
local: Yeah, on this stage of July 29, 1958,
native: Yeah, on this stage of July 29, 1958,

en: NASA was created.
zh: NASA成立了。
ja: NASAが設立されました。
local: NASA was created.
native: NASA was created.

en: The agency has been responsible for space expeditions,
zh: 該機構負責太空探險，
ja: この機関は宇宙探査を担当してきました、
local: The agency has been responsible for space expeditions,
native: The agency has been responsible for space expeditions,

en: both human and mechanical that have yielded vital information
zh: 包括人類和機械的探險，提供了重要資訊，
ja: 人間と機械の両方の探査で、重要な情報をもたらしました、
local: both human and mechanical that have yielded vital information
native: both human and mechanical that have yielded vital information

en: about the solar system and the universe.
zh: 關於太陽系和宇宙的資訊。
ja: 太陽系と宇宙に関する情報です。
local: about the solar system and the universe.
native: about the solar system and the universe.

en: NASA was created in response to the Soviet Union's launch
zh: NASA的成立是為了回應蘇聯發射
ja: NASAはソ連の打ち上げに対応して設立されました
local: NASA was created in response to the Soviet Union's launch
native: NASA was created in response to the Soviet Union's launch

en: of its first satellite, Sputnik 1,
zh: 其第一顆衛星「史潑尼克1號」，
ja: 最初の衛星スプートニク1号の打ち上げです。
local: of its first satellite, Sputnik 1,
native: of its first satellite, Sputnik 1,

en: the 183-pound basketball-sized satellite
zh: 這顆重183磅、大小如籃球的衛星
ja: 183ポンドのバスケットボールサイズの衛星は、
local: the 183-pound basketball-sized satellite
native: the 183-pound basketball-sized satellite

en: orbited the Earth in 98 minutes.
zh: 在98分鐘內繞地球一圈。
ja: 98分で地球を周回しました。
local: orbited the Earth in 98 minutes.
native: orbited the Earth in 98 minutes.

en: The Sputnik launch caught Americans by surprise
zh: 史潑尼克的發射讓美國人感到驚訝，
ja: スプートニクの打ち上げはアメリカ人を驚かせ、
local: The Sputnik launch caught Americans by surprise
native: The Sputnik launch caught Americans by surprise

en: and sparked fears that Soviets might also be capable
zh: 並引發了對蘇聯可能也有能力
ja: そしてソ連がまた能力を持っているのではないかという恐怖を引き起こしました、
local: and sparked fears that Soviets might also be capable
native: and sparked fears that Soviets might also be capable

en: of sending missiles with nuclear weapons from Europe to America.
zh: 從歐洲向美國發射搭載核武器的導彈。
ja: ヨーロッパからアメリカへ核兵器搭載ミサイルを発射できるのではないかという恐れです。
local: of sending missiles with nuclear weapons from Europe to America.
native: of sending missiles with nuclear weapons from Europe to America.

en: The United States prided itself on being at the forefront of technology
zh: 美國以處於科技前沿為傲，
ja: アメリカは技術の最先端にいることを誇りに思っており、
local: The United States prided itself on being at the forefront of technology
native: The United States prided itself on being at the forefront of technology

en: and embarrassed it immediately began developing a response,
zh: 感到尷尬，立即開始發展對策，
ja: 恥ずかしく思い、すぐに対応策の開発を始めました、
local: and embarrassed it immediately began developing a response,
native: and embarrassed it immediately began developing a response,

en: signaling the start of the US Soviet Space Race.
zh: 標誌著美蘇太空競賽的開始。
ja: これが米ソ宇宙競争の始まりを告げました。
local: signaling the start of the US Soviet Space Race.
native: signaling the start of the US Soviet Space Race.

en: On July 20, 1969, NASA's Apollo 11 mission made history
zh: 1969年7月20日，NASA的阿波羅11號任務創造了歷史，
ja: 1969年7月20日、NASAのアポロ11号ミッションが歴史を作りました、
local: On July 20, 1969, NASA's Apollo 11 mission made history
native: On July 20, 1969, NASA's Apollo 11 mission made history

en: when astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first person
zh: 當時宇航員尼爾·阿姆斯壯成為第一個人，
ja: 宇宙飛行士ニール・アームストロングが最初の人となったのです、
local: when astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first person
native: when astronaut Neil Armstrong became the first person

en: to set foot on the moon famously declaring
zh: 踏上月球，並著名地宣稱
ja: 月に足を踏み入れ、有名な言葉を述べました、
local: to set foot on the moon famously declaring
native: to set foot on the moon famously declaring

en: that's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
zh: 這是個人的一小步，卻是人類的一大步。
ja: それは人間にとって小さな一歩だが、人類にとっては大きな飛躍だ。
local: that's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
native: that's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.

en: NASA has continued to make great advances in space exploration
zh: NASA持續在太空探索方面取得重大進展，
ja: NASAは宇宙探査で大きな進歩を続けています、
local: NASA has continued to make great advances in space exploration
native: NASA has continued to make great advances in space exploration

en: since the first moonwalk, including playing a major part
zh: 自首次登月以來，包括在國際太空站建設中扮演重要角色，
ja: 最初の月面歩行以来、国際宇宙ステーションの建設にも大きく関わっています、
local: since the first moonwalk, including playing a major part
native: since the first moonwalk, including playing a major part

en: in the construction of the International Space Station.
zh: 參與國際太空站的建造。
ja: 国際宇宙ステーションの建設において重要な役割を果たしています。
local: in the construction of the International Space Station.
native: in the construction of the International Space Station.

en: That's the stay in history for July 29.
zh: 這就是7月29日的歷史回顧。
ja: これが7月29日の歴史の出来事です。
local: That's the stay in history for July 29.
native: That's the stay in history for July 29.

en: And we learned last month that you remember exactly
zh: 我們上個月得知你還清楚記得
ja: そして先月、あなたが正確に覚えていることを知りました、
local: And we learned last month that you remember exactly
native: And we learned last month that you remember exactly

en: where you were watching that first moon landing,
zh: 你當時在哪裡觀看那次首次登月，
ja: その最初の月面着陸をどこで見ていたかを、
local: where you were watching that first moon landing,
native: where you were watching that first moon landing,

en: which is so cool.
zh: 這真是太酷了。
ja: それはとても素敵なことです。
local: which is so cool.
native: which is so cool.

en: I do. I can remember the kitchen table even.
zh: 我記得。我甚至記得廚房的桌子。
ja: 覚えています。キッチンのテーブルまでも覚えています。
local: I do. I can remember the kitchen table even.
native: I do. I can remember the kitchen table even.

en: That's just so wild.
zh: 那真是太不可思議了。
ja: それは本当にすごいことです。
local: That's just so wild.
native: That's just so wild.

en: Todd, yeah, but I have zero memory prior to that.
zh: 托德，是的，但我之前完全沒有記憶。
ja: トッド、そうだけど、それ以前の記憶は全くありません。
local: Todd, yeah, but I have zero memory prior to that.
native: Todd, yeah, but I have zero memory prior to that.

en: Birth, moon.
zh: 出生，月亮。
ja: 誕生、月。
local: Birth, moon.
native: Birth, moon.

en: Birth, moon.
zh: 出生，月亮。
ja: 誕生、月。
local: Birth, moon.
native: Birth, moon.

en: Birth, moon, moon.
zh: 出生，月亮，月亮。
ja: 誕生、月、月。
local: Birth, moon, moon.
native: Birth, moon, moon.

en: Yeah, birth, table and man walking on the moon.
zh: 是的，出生、桌子和人在月球上行走。
ja: そう、誕生、テーブル、そして月面を歩く人。
local: Yeah, birth, table and man walking on the moon.
native: Yeah, birth, table and man walking on the moon.

en: It's everything prior to that is just a big blank.
zh: 那之前的一切都是一片空白。
ja: それ以前のすべてはただの空白です。
local: It's everything prior to that is just a big blank.
native: It's everything prior to that is just a big blank.

en: Oh, man.
zh: 喔，天啊。
ja: ああ、もう。
local: Oh, man.
native: Oh, man.

en: Well, yeah, it's just super impressive
zh: 嗯，是的，這真的非常令人印象深刻，
ja: そうですね、本当にとても感動的です、
local: Well, yeah, it's just super impressive
native: Well, yeah, it's just super impressive

en: what these astronauts are capable of.
zh: 這些宇航員能做到的事情。
ja: 宇宙飛行士たちができることは素晴らしいです。
local: what these astronauts are capable of.
native: what these astronauts are capable of.

en: And even for that last orbit around the moon,
zh: 甚至在最後一次繞月軌道上，
ja: そして最後の月周回でも、
local: And even for that last orbit around the moon,
native: And even for that last orbit around the moon,

en: we learned that there was a astronaut,
zh: 我們得知有一位宇航員，
ja: 宇宙飛行士がいたことを知りました、
local: we learned that there was a astronaut,
native: we learned that there was a astronaut,

en: somebody within NASA from Green Bay who we spoke with.
zh: 我們與來自綠灣的NASA成員交談過。
ja: グリーンベイ出身のNASAの関係者と話をしました。
local: somebody within NASA from Green Bay who we spoke with.
native: somebody within NASA from Green Bay who we spoke with.

en: So it's just super cool to see all of these Wisconsin connections.
zh: 所以看到所有這些威斯康辛的聯繫真的很酷。
ja: だから、これらのウィスコンシンとのつながりを見るのは本当にかっこいいです。
local: So it's just super cool to see all of these Wisconsin connections.
native: So it's just super cool to see all of these Wisconsin connections.

en: To NASA as well, Charlie, thank you.
zh: 也感謝NASA，查理，謝謝你。
ja: NASAにも感謝します、チャーリー、ありがとう。
local: To NASA as well, Charlie, thank you.
native: To NASA as well, Charlie, thank you.
